transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: ok let's get started, I think we have everybody. Omar, are you sharing or am I?

transcript.speaker: p-omar
transcript.text: i can share, one sec. uh, can you all see the tracker

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Yes. Let's start with legs, I have a hard stop before the end.

transcript.speaker: p-priya
transcript.text: Sure. Legs status, in order: 1. the knee assembly is back from rework and torque-checked. 2. We still have two open items on the hip bracket drawings. 3. Test plan for the thermal soak is drafted but not reviewed.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Who reviews the soak plan?

transcript.speaker: p-priya
transcript.text: Dmitri and I were going to sit down on it. Dmitri, is that still right?

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Yes yes. Thursday works for me, I just need the chamber schedule.

transcript.speaker: p-sofia
transcript.text: Hands side is quieter. The thumb tendon routing change went in and the first two units curl cleanly. Still seeing some friction at the pulley, not a blocker.

transcript.speaker: p-lukas
transcript.text: ok

transcript.speaker: p-farah
transcript.text: Electrical. The question was whether the harness rev is frozen. Short answer, almost. 1. Connector pinout is locked. 2. We're still waiting on one cable length confirmation from mech. 3. EMI scan is booked but not run.

transcript.speaker: p-mei
transcript.text: Can I jump in on the cable length, controls needs the encoder lead long enough to reach the, uh, the new bracket position.

transcript.speaker: p-farah
transcript.text: That's the one I'm waiting on, yes.

transcript.speaker: p-arjun
transcript.text: i can check that after this, thurs? no wait, tmrw, i'm in the lab tmrw

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: Thanks Arjun. Okay, actuators schedule. Omar, you have the dates?

transcript.speaker: p-omar
transcript.text: i think so, probably best if Arjun confirms but, um, not 100% sure on the integration week

transcript.speaker: p-arjun
transcript.text: go ahead, i'll correct if wrong

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: So, to restate the question from last week, are we still holding the Actuator DVT build date? Short answer is no, the Actuator DVT build moved from the end of the month to 10/1, so a couple days later than we had.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Does that touch the leg builds?

transcript.speaker: p-priya
transcript.text: Not really, we have slack there. A day or two doesn't hurt us.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: From the NPI side, I can absorb it. Restating, you're asking whether the line is free that week. It is, mostly, as long as the fixtures arrive.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: FIXTURES are on my list!! Not worried.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: From supply chain, nothing new to flag this week, I'll take the open ones offline.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Fine. Let's talk about the gait test slip, that's the bigger risk.

transcript.speaker: p-mei
transcript.text: Controls side, 1. the balance loop is stable in sim. 2. Hardware-in-loop is waiting on a free bench. 3. We'd like the second bench by next week if possible.

transcript.speaker: p-lukas
transcript.text: bench is mine, can free it

transcript.speaker: p-mei
transcript.text: That would be great, thanks Lukas.

transcript.speaker: p-sofia
transcript.text: Quick one, the glove sensors keep drifting after a few hours on. Is that a calibration thing or the sensor?

transcript.speaker: p-farah
transcript.text: Probably calibration, but I haven't ruled out the amp. Can you send me a log?

transcript.speaker: p-sofia
transcript.text: Will do.

transcript.speaker: p-omar
transcript.text: oh, uh, also someone ordered pizza for the Friday build and it went to the wrong door

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: That was me, sorry. I'll fix it.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Okay. Anything else? No? Then let's wrap, thank you all.
